content: dms-window-buttons v1.0.0 silent no-op: NiriService.send behind Quickshell.env(NIRI_SOCKET) guard — DMS env has NO NIRI_SOCKET (starts from user dinit/turnstile, not niri child); close worked (native toplevel.close). v1.0.1: niri msg action with self-resolved $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/niri*.sock; buttons = down/up move-column-to-workspace-*, maximize-column (=Mod+F), close.

KDE apps dark: KColorScheme reads ~/.config/kdeglobals [Colors:*] (ksystemlog: direct, hardcoded Breeze Light without it; okular: KColorSchemeManager looks for .colors files in XDG data dirs first, falls back to kdeglobals system scheme). Portal/QPalette path already dark (xdgdesktopportal + portal prefer-dark; Qt 6.11 fusion colorScheme-aware). Fix: installer seeds kdeglobals with self-contained BreezeDark [Colors:*]+[ColorEffects:*] (upstream BreezeDark.colors LGPL-2.0-or-later, translations dropped) + [Icons] Theme=breeze-dark. NOT via Alpine breeze pkg (only carrier; pulls qt5+kf5 ~100MB). NOTE [General] ColorScheme in kdeglobals is LEGACY; KF6 >=6.16 uses [UiSettings] ColorScheme=<id> + scheme files — we skip both, kdeglobals colors are enough.

KDE dark: (1) kcolorscheme EMBEDS BreezeDark/BreezeLight as Qt resources (:org.kde.kcolorscheme/color-schemes) — KColorSchemeManager apps (okular) resolve scheme by [UiSettings] ColorScheme=<id> (KF6>=6.16; [General] is legacy), and UNPINNED follow styleHints colorScheme (not dark in okular's process → embedded BreezeLight applied, kdeglobals [Colors:*] BYPASSED). Pin [UiSettings] ColorScheme=BreezeDark → embedded BreezeDark (no .colors file needed; user-dir file would shadow — avoid). Non-manager apps (ksystemlog) read kdeglobals [Colors:*] directly (seeded). (2) ReGreet 0.2.0 lists /etc/passwd users UID [login.defs 1000,60000] — greeter was 1001 → visible; fixed with adduser -S (system UID 100-999 filtered; turnstile fine with non-root; explicit -s overrides busybox nologin default). Harness: greetd_config UID assert + theme_dark BreezeDark-pin assert.

First harness run 18-42-54Z caught 2 in the BreezeDark-pin round: (1) busybox adduser -S WITHOUT -G sets primary group to nogroup and creates NO same-name group (loginutils/adduser.c: usegroup = "nogroup") -> chown -R greeter:greeter failed -> log_errors FAIL. Fix: getent group greeter || addgroup -S greeter; adduser -S -G greeter. (2) Harness greetd_config check contained a POSIX apostrophe escape inside the command; ssh runs checks through the installed user's FISH login shell whose single-quote escaping differs -> 'fish: Unexpected )' exit 127. Fix: double-quoted echo with plain apostrophe (no backslash nesting). Proven in alpine+fish docker: new R parses, old reproduces exact error. Re-run 18-52-07Z = 97/97 PASS (greetd_config + theme_dark green, chown OK).

Flatpak theming: ~/.local/share/flatpak/overrides/global with filesystems=xdg-config/kdeglobals:ro;xdg-config/gtk-3.0:ro;xdg-config/gtk-4.0:ro; + GTK_THEME=Adwaita:dark — sandbox can't see host config; KDE flatpaks need the kdeglobals bind (embedded BreezeDark via UiSettings pin); GTK4/portal flatpaks follow portal automatically (host portal = u 1). Host KDE apps pixel-verified dark (okular+ksystemlog on run 18-52-07Z). Also fixed: user niri config lacked hotkey-overlay skip-at-startup (overlay popped every login; greeter had it).

User-review corrections: (1) hotkey-overlay skip-at-startup REVERTED in user niri config — overlay wanted by user (do not touch); (2) flatpak override = binds only (no forced GTK_THEME env — apps must follow DMS theme); (3) final chown -R user:user ~/.config ~/.local sweep — seed dirs were root-owned (per-seed chowns cover files only; general chown runs before seeds).

Manual theme seeds REMOVED pending dms-theme-sync adoption (third-party DMS plugin arqueon/dms-theme-sync GPL-3.0 syncs DMS appearance to GTK/Qt/KDE/Flatpak). Kept: dconf pkg+profile, session.json dark seed. Harness theme_dark dropped (to be re-added plugin-based).

dconf update fails without /etc/dconf/db/local.d — Alpine dconf package ships no /etc/dconf at all (verified: apk add dconf in clean container). Installer must mkdir -p the system-db dir before dconf update; former seed write hid this by side effect. Harness log_errors caught it (run 22-09-52Z).

Phase A VALIDATED: manual theme seed removal clean install run 2026-10-12T22-19-18Z 96/96 PASS (theme_dark removed; dms_icons trimmed). installer.log zero kdeglobals/gtk settings/00-feralos-theme/flatpak override seed writes; dconf profile+mkdir+update OK. Next: Phase B live dms-theme-sync plugin test via debug_run (port 2224).
